column1: # Curated JWST distance-anchor seed for CF4 cross-match (pre-solver forecast input).
# These galaxies have published JWST-based distances (TRGB / JAGB / Cepheid); the seed
# carries the anchor identity + the published JWST distance-modulus precision (jwst_e_dm_mag)
# NOT a re-derived distance -- the bulk-flow forecast uses the ERROR (Fisher weight)
# velocity comes from CF4. The authoritative machine-readable tables are fetched by
# dl_pipeline/scripts/download_jwst_anchors.py; this seed makes the forecast runnable offline.
#          Riess et al. 2024/2025 (SH0ES JWST Cepheids). Coordinates are J2000 host centres.
